lead.headline: Tuten ruled out; Diggs takes the seat
lead.deck: Jacksonville sat him after three missed practices. One swap before Sunday noon; Likely is cleared.
lead.body: Bad news first. Jacksonville ruled Bhayshul Tuten out for Sunday on Friday afternoon, after he missed every practice of the week with the ankle and foot. He is still in your RB slot and ESPN still shows his 18.7 — that number will be a zero. Move Ollie Gordon II to RB and start Stefon Diggs in FLEX before 12:00 Sunday. The rest of the news is better: Isaiah Likely, limited twice with the groin, carries no designation on the Giants' final report, so his fallback is retired; Diggs practised in full Thursday; Cousins starts for Minnesota with Jordan Addison out. Warren had 4.4 at Pittsburgh at 22:05Z. You trail Footballers by 53.
